precedence: This override supersedes conflicting or incomplete statements about ordinary Student Login Manager batch selection/provisioning only. All non-conflicting Portal V2, Replace Resource and shared-Worker composition authority remains binding.

change.name: Create new batch from existing batch settings
change.baselineCommitMessage: Add Admin facility to create new student batches

requiredBehaviour.batchKeyRule: Canonicalise to uppercase and validate before mutation.
requiredBehaviour.templateRule: The selected existing batch is the settings template; the new batch remains a distinct batch key.
requiredBehaviour.activeFromRule: Use the requested activeFrom date for the new batch rather than silently inheriting the template's start date.
requiredBehaviour.timestampRule: Every new batch_definitions insert must supply created_at and updated_at because both columns are NOT NULL in the canonical Phase 12 schema.
requiredBehaviour.errorClassificationRule: Only a real primary-key/UNIQUE collision on batch_definitions.batch_key may be returned as BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS. Other SQL constraints must remain BATCH_CREATE_FAILED and must never be misreported as a duplicate.
requiredBehaviour.postCreateUi: Refresh active batches, select the newly created batch for the student when it becomes available, and preserve existing Student Login Manager provisioning flow.
requiredBehaviour.duplicateRecoveryRule: If create returns BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS, the Admin UI refreshes the active-batch list and selects that existing batch automatically when it is active. If it remains absent, show a short message that the batch code is already in use and require a different code; do not mutate historical rows implicitly.
requiredBehaviour.dropdownPresentation: In Copy settings from, render at least one visible space between the batch code and its human-readable type/description so values such as Y411OE and Year 4 / 11+ English do not run together.

incident20260925.symptom: Creating Y411OE2 showed BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS even though Y411OE2 did not appear in the active-batch list.
incident20260925.rootCause: The new INSERT INTO batch_definitions omitted mandatory created_at and updated_at values. D1 therefore raised a NOT NULL constraint failure. The catch block matched any error containing the word constraint and incorrectly converted that failure into BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
incident20260925.repair: Supply created_at and updated_at on insert and narrow duplicate classification to the batch_key UNIQUE/primary-key condition only.
incident20260925.userExperience: Keep the workflow simple: create the batch, refresh/select it, then create the student. Do not expose internal database-state diagnostics for ordinary successful use.

safetyAndPreservation: Do not mutate an existing batch definition when creating a new batch.
Do not create or modify a student merely by creating the batch definition.
Do not claim a requested batch or student exists until the authenticated mutation and readback complete.
Do not overwrite or repurpose an inactive historical batch automatically merely because its key collides with a requested new batch.
Do not alter normal-student multi-device session semantics.
Do not alter Trial one-successful-login semantics.
Do not alter lesson release, prepared access projection, protected Answer Pack, PreLesson/VR or quiz-bridge behaviour.
Shared Worker production deployment must retain the composed quiz bridge -> Admin Tools chain and all existing preservation gates.

completionBoundary.engineeringChange: Batch creation is valid only when the Worker writes every mandatory batch_definitions field, reads the created row back, and the Admin can refresh/select it.
completionBoundary.productionMutation: A particular new batch is not considered created until the Admin API mutation succeeds and the new batch is observed in the refreshed active-batch list.
completionBoundary.studentProvisioning: A student login is not considered provisioned until the existing create-student transaction and its prepared access publication/readback gates succeed.

verificationMatrix: Verify batch INSERT explicitly supplies created_at and updated_at.
Verify a generic NOT NULL/CHECK constraint is not classified as BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
Verify a real batch_key UNIQUE collision is classified as BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
Verify unauthenticated batch creation remains rejected.
Verify a valid new batch is copied from the intended template with the requested activeFrom date.
Verify a newly created active batch is refreshed and selected automatically in the Admin UI.
Verify the Admin dropdown displays a visible separator space between batch code and description.
After any shared Worker production deploy, rerun the existing shared-capability regression gates.
authorityUpdateRule: If batch-definition fields, endpoint shape, template-copy semantics, SQL constraint handling, provisioning coupling, or validation rules change, update this override and GCH_CURRENT.json in the same coherent change.
